meta.title: Task Manager
meta.description: A lightweight task manager with an idea pool and reviews: today, week, all-task and idea views, plus a daily/weekly/monthly review area at the bottom of the Today view (written by the human, read-only for agents). Tasks support single-day and multi-day ranges with optional times; ideas have status, maturity and long descriptions. Agents can read/write tasks and idea content and read reviews, but only a human can complete a task, change an idea status or write a review.
